harness.note: The better-borg-c runner and observer at this commit build and run every specimen. A specimen is the game and Borg source at its own ref; the observer instrumentation comes from the harness commit. It applies to specimens of kind "better-borg-c" (the default). Specimens of kind "borg-rs" are built and run by borg-rs's own harness at the specimen's ref (harness/build.sh and the borgh frontend). This pin is also a specimen ref (4.2.6-bbc-9ca98661): the harness bumped with the mode-cutoff restart so runner and specimens move together (borg-zoo#54).

experiment.prespecified:
Fixed 2026-11-25 in borg-zoo#786, before any result was read. Two arms on PR #1215's head 4f56f7fa: ctl (both switches 0,
C's play) and shipped (both 1). defend_prep_mana_starved holds the "some danger" prep spells (Hero, Berserk Strength, Rapid
Regeneration) at full HP with SP at or below MAXSP/4; recover_mana_rest_full_hp lets the full-HP mana rest read the general
recovery gate. Pilot, then the ladder classes-1800 starts 1-360 (verysmall, small-rest, medium) on the pilot's gate; big and
full on the owner's word.
Gate: no config_error; one binary; each arm's two switch values in params-core.json; every cell ends in death, turn_cap or
borg_stopped; stalls and wall timeouts apart. Primary endpoints per arm against ctl (exact McNemar): stuck games
(borg-zoo#732's flag — the recorded loop is one) and recovery deaths (dying while SP-starved with cures uncast). The
no-regression probe of the prep buffs: the count of Heroism/Berserk Strength/Rapid Regeneration casts per 1,000 turns, with
the pre/post states of a sample of casts read from the traces (HP, SP, the nearest visible monster) — the buffs are useful
when a fight is real; the switch must not disarm them where it mattered. Descriptive CL/depth/deaths per arm; no improvement
claim without the prespecified margins (RULES 14).
experiment.question: On PR #1215's head 4f56f7fa (the DL19 recovery-loop fix of #1211), what do the shipped switches change against C's play (both off): deaths, progress, stuck games, recovery deaths — and do the prep buffs still fire where a fight was real?
